app.name: Lexora
app.tagline: Answers from your company documents, with the source cited.

login.title: Sign in
login.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.

upload.drop: Drop files here or click to choose
upload.hint: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, TXT, MD or CSV, up to {max} each.
upload.format: Format not accepted. Use PDF, DOCX, XLSX, TXT, MD or CSV.
upload.archived: The base is archived and does not accept documents.

actions.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? It leaves the search and the chat.
actions.reprocessConfirm: “{name}” will be processed again and stays out of the search until it finishes. Continue?

knowledgeBases.subtitle: Each base gathers the documents of one subject. The chat answers only from the documents of the chosen base.
knowledgeBases.emptyAdminHint: Create the first base to upload documents.

form.name: Name
form.chunkingHint: Maximum size of each chunk and how much it repeats from the previous one, in tokens. The change applies to documents uploaded or reprocessed afterwards.
form.nameLength: The name must have {min} to {max} characters.
form.descriptionLength: The description can have up to {max} characters.
form.chunkOverlapRange: Use a value from 0 to {max} (half the chunk size).

settings.reindexHint: Processes every indexed document again. Use it after changing the embedding model.
settings.reindexConfirm: Every indexed document will be processed again and stays out of the search until it finishes. Continue?
settings.reindexed: No documents to reindex. | 1 document sent to reprocessing. | {count} documents sent to reprocessing.
settings.archiveHint: The base stops receiving documents. Search and chat keep working.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The address does not exist or you do not have access to it.

search.placeholder: Ask or type terms to search the documents

modeHints.hybrid: Combines the meaning of the question with the exact words.
modeHints.vector: Finds excerpts with the same meaning, even in other words.
modeHints.keyword: Finds excerpts that have every typed word.

search.results: No excerpts found | 1 excerpt found | {count} excerpts found
search.empty: Nothing found. Try other words or the semantic search.
search.idle: Search the documents of this base to see the most relevant excerpts.

notifications.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. Try again.

network.unavailable: Could not reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
